title: Robert Woods 2023 Prizm TEXANS #123
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: Own a piece of football history with this Robert Woods 2023 Prizm trading card featuring the Houston Texans. This card is part of the base set and has the card number 123. The card is in standard size and is manufactured by Panini. It is an English language card and features the National Football League (NFL) league. The card is not autographed and is not vintage. It is a sports trading card and is perfect for any football enthusiast. Add this card to your collection and show off your love for the sport.
